name: Energy Mastery (Item Mastery, Mythic)
body:
You can unleash an inferno of your chosen element from your magic item.

Prerequisite(s): Energy Mastery.

Benefit(s): You gain an additional daily use of Energy Mastery for every odd mythic tier you possess. You can force the item to cast flame strike by spending 3 daily uses of the feat, delayed blast fireball by spending 4 daily uses, or meteor swarm by spending 5 daily uses. If you also expend one use of mythic power, you can cast the mythic version of the selected spell instead. All these spells still have the energy descriptor from the appropriate requirement spell and deal that type of damage instead of their normal damage.
